source_title: Introduction To The Envato Subscription License
snippet_primary: "Unlike licensing models that restrict usage by location or platform, Envato subscription uses project-based licensing. Each license covers one complete project, regardless of where or how that project is shared or distributed."
subject_exact: Envato Elements policy states the subscription license is project-based; each license covers one complete project regardless of where or how the project is distributed
local_qualifiers: Envato subscription license: project-based (one license per complete project)
no restrictions by location or platform for distribution
contrasts with models that restrict usage by location or platform
parser_notes: Envato Elements help center (accessed April 2026, undated). Subscription license: project-based; one license covers one complete project regardless of distribution channel.
